requirementResults.reason: The assistant correctly cited the 2024 IRC Appendix BL, but failed to include the local caveat that adoption and permitting depend on the local jurisdiction.
The assistant clearly explained that hempcrete is strictly non-load-bearing and that a conventional timber frame must carry the roof and floor loads.
The assistant answered the timeline question in method-conditional terms, distinguishing pre-cast blocks from cast-in-situ and noting the 3-6 weeks drying time required for the latter.
